The medium term facility was made available to finance a portion of the consideration for the purchase of Total Marketing
Kenya Limited. It is denominated in Kenya Shillings and is repayable in quarterly principal installments over a period of 5 years.
The first installment was due on 31 March 2010.
The loan is secured by;
a) All assets debenture.
b) Pledge of shares in Total Marketing Kenya Limited.
c) Mortgage granted over the property known as LR Number 214/110, Nairobi.
d) Charge granted over the property known as LR Number 3734/383, Nairobi.
e) Charge granted over the property known as LR Number 209/15789, Nairobi
The weighted average effective interest rate on the borrowings is 10.51% (2009: 11.56%).
